panels.title: True Wind Direction (compass, computed)
panels.description: Computed as heading (nmea_heading_magnetic) + apparent wind angle (nmea_awa), mod 360 — not a direct instrument reading (no TWD sentence on this boat's NMEA feed). Only equals the real compass bearing when boat speed ≈ 0, which is exactly the anchor case this dashboard is built for. Underway, use WeatherAWA instead — apparent wind is skewed by boat motion there.

targets.query:
hdg = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_heading_magnetic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _row: 1, _field: "hdg" }))
awa = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_awa")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _row: 1, _field: "awa" }))
union(tables: [hdg, awa])
  |> group(columns: ["_row"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_row"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with twd: (r.hdg + r.awa) % 360.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "twd"])
  |> yield(name: "twd")

panels.title: Wind Trend — Last Hour (fixed window, 1min resolution)
Wind Speed — Last Hour
panels.description: Apparent only (AWS, the raw masthead instrument reading) — TWS is the instrument's own AWS+SOG+heading correction, which is a no-op at anchor (SOG≈0), so it'd just retrace AWS on this dashboard. See WeatherAWA/the 24h panel here if you want the computed series too.

targets.query:

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sensor.nmea_aws")

panels.title: Wind Rose — True Direction Frequency (24h)
panels.description: heading + AWA (mod 360), bucketed into 16 compass sectors, counted over the last 24h, plotted as a north-up polar rose (N is up, clockwise) — anchor-accurate compass bearing, not relative-to-bow. Grafana has no native radial-grid panel, so this is an XY Chart faking polar via Cartesian x/y = count·sin/cos(angle); the background grid is a plain square, not compass rings, and the two axes autoscale independently so the shape's proportions can look stretched depending on the data — read direction and relative petal length, not the axis numbers. A rose smeared across many sectors means the wind (or your swing) has been all over the place; a tight single petal means it's settled.

targets.query:
import "math"
import "array"
dirs = ["N","NNE","NE","ENE","E","ESE","SE","SSE","S","SSW","SW","WSW","W","WNW","NW","NNW"]
zeros = array.from(rows: [
  {sector: 0.0, dir: "N"}, {sector: 1.0, dir: "NNE"}, {sector: 2.0, dir: "NE"}, {sector: 3.0, dir: "ENE"},
  {sector: 4.0, dir: "E"}, {sector: 5.0, dir: "ESE"}, {sector: 6.0, dir: "SE"}, {sector: 7.0, dir: "SSE"},
  {sector: 8.0, dir: "S"}, {sector: 9.0, dir: "SSW"}, {sector: 10.0, dir: "SW"}, {sector: 11.0, dir: "WSW"},
  {sector: 12.0, dir: "W"}, {sector: 13.0, dir: "WNW"}, {sector: 14.0, dir: "NW"}, {sector: 15.0, dir: "NNW"}
]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with count: 0 }))
hdg = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_heading_magnetic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "hdg" }))
awa = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_awa")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "awa" }))
real = union(tables: [hdg, awa])
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.hdg and exists r.awa)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with twd: (r.hdg + r.awa) % 360.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with sector: math.floor(x: (r.twd / 22.5)) }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with dir: dirs[int(v: r.sector)] }))
  |> group(columns: ["sector", "dir"])
  |> count(column: "twd")
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {twd: "count"})
  |> keep(columns: ["sector", "dir", "count"])
rose = union(tables: [real, zeros])
  |> group(columns: ["sector", "dir"])
  |> sum(column: "count")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["sector"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with rad: r.sector * 22.5 * 3.14159265358979 / 180.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with x: float(v: r.count) * math.sin(x: r.rad), y: float(v: r.count) * math.cos(x: r.rad) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["sector", "dir", "x", "y"])
closeLoop = rose |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sector == 0.0) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with sector: 16.0 }))
union(tables: [rose, closeLoop])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["sector"])
  |> keep(columns: ["dir", "x", "y"])
  |> yield(name: "windrose")

panels.title: Pressure Trend (3h)
panels.description: Now vs. ~3h ago. A steady fall is the classic front-approaching signal — worth more than the raw number.

targets.query:
cur = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "cur" }))
old = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -3h30m, stop: -2h30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "old" }))
union(tables: [cur, old])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with delta: r.cur - r.old }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "delta"])
  |> yield(name: "delta")
